messages:
jordan: Customer on Hosted API reporting SSE streams that cut off mid-event when traffic goes through their gRPC gateway -> our edge. They see partial JSON payloads, client reconnects, then a second partial. Customer also flagged duplicate billing for the reconnect. Request id: req-0a1b2c3d. Anyone seen H2->H1 intermediary re-chunking hit this pattern?

samir: Can you confirm if direct calls to our API (no gateway) stream fine? Need headers + a minimal repro (curl). Also paste edge request id.

jordan: Direct to api.redwood-inference.com streams fine. Problem reproducible only when their gateway (Envoy grpc_web + h1 bridge) is in path. Edge logs: stream closed after ~4s, status 200, but downstream sent larger chunks and then FIN mid-event. No 5xx from gateway. Edge request id r-x234.

jordan: ```bash
# quick repro (their topology: client h2 -> gateway -> our edge http1)
curl -v --http2-prior-knowledge "https://their-gw.example/stream-proxy" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" \n  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  -d '{"prompt":"long text","max_tokens":2000}'
```

tianna: Sounds like the intermediary is buffering and coalescing frames, then closing due to upstream idle/window timeout before the event delimiter. Two things to get: tcpdump/pcap from their gateway and our edge's raw bytes (we log frames). Also check whether the gateway translates grpc-web and rewrites transfer-encoding.

jordan: Pasted edge raw (trimmed):
```
[upstream -> downstream] chunked: "event: chunk\ndata: {\"text\":\"....partial....\n"\n[downstream] coalesced chunk: "event: chunk\ndata: {\"text\":\"....partial....}\n\n"\n[downstream] FIN sent before next event
```
No auth failures. Billing shows two entries for same request id but different session ids.

samir: Two action items: (1) Try repro with curl --http2 and curl --http1.1 to see framing differences. (2) Ask customer whether their gateway is doing grpc-web -> http1 translation or using a bridge that buffers until a trailer. Some proxies buffer until they see `Content-Length` or EOF.

alex_support: Customer also mentioned they do token rotation every 30s; reconnects lead to two separate auth checks which looked like double billing on our side. We should recommend keeping tokens valid across reconnect for streaming.

tianna: Troubleshooting tips:
```
# HTTP/2 direct (expected good streaming)
curl -v --http2 "https://edge.redwood-inference.com/v1/stream" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx"
# Force HTTP/1.1 to simulate gateway->edge path
curl -v --http1.1 "https://edge.redwood-inference.com/v1/stream" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" ...
# Local envoy bridge example to reproduce h2->h1 behavior (envoy config snippet)
# check: common_http_protocol_options.idle_timeout, upstream_stream_idle_timeout, preserve_external_request_id
```
Also check Envoy filters: grpc_web converts frames and sometimes coalesces until trailers.

jordan: Customer runs Envoy 1.25 with grpc_web + http1 bridge. They tweaked keepalive and saw fewer disconnects but still partial events occasionally. Trace id: 0a1b2c3d.

samir: Hypothesis: Our runtime flushes small SSE chunks (to reduce latency) -> intermediary coalesces them -> when it hits its window/idle cutoff it sends FIN that truncates an in-progress event. When client reconnects, it gets another partial since server replays remaining tokens, causing perceived duplication/billing.

tianna: Possible mitigations:
- Short term: increase upstream idle timeout on our edge for this customer (we can do a targeted config bump).
- Customer side: tune Envoy params: `upstream_stream_idle_timeout`, `stream_idle_timeout`, and reduce buffering in grpc_web filter.
- Product/Dev: can we ensure SSE events always end with a double newline flush `\n\n` at safe checkpoints so coalescing doesn't cut an event mid-message?

alex_support: For billing: we can group events by `X-Request-Id` and if duplicates occur within a short window treat as a single billable operation pending finance approval. Logged CS-9876.

edge-bot: Automated note: increased edge idle timeout for cust-982 by +30s at 2024-06-02T19:04:00Z for testing.

jordan: Customer will run overnight load & report back tomorrow. Thanks team :thumbsup:

samir: Follow-ups: devs - please evaluate feasibility of: (1) appending explicit SSE terminators at flush points, (2) exposing a per-tenant streaming config to control flush granularity, (3) adding persistent `X-Stream-Session` that survives reconnects so we can dedupe billing.
tianna: Filing infra ticket INF-1229 to track edge timeout tuning and X-Stream-Session header.
alex_support: I'll keep billing on hold until we hear customer confirmation. Marking as high-priority until repro confirmed.
